en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Two days from now, at the stroke of nighttime,
that's when the time limit expires...

<CLT=cltMIND>Until then, I guess I'll check on the others.
I'm a little worried about them...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>While at the academy, you will have
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Free Time<CLT=cltSYSTEM> every now and then.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>During Free Time, you can spend time with other
students to <CLT=cltSTRONG>strengthen your bond<CLT=cltSYSTEM> with them.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can also give them a <CLT=cltSTRONG>present<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
to strengthen those bonds further.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can buy presents at the School Store or
win them at the <CLT=cltSTRONG>MonoMono Machine<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If your bond gets strong enough, an
<CLT=cltSTRONG>intimate event<CLT=cltSYSTEM> might occur. Nice!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>But you don't have Free Time forever.
Spending time with someone passes...time.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can also end Free Time by going
straight to bed. By yourself, that is.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>I mean, I wouldn't skip it, but if
you'd rather be alone, that's cool too...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wish I had a big TV like this at my house.
I'll ask Dad to get me one after I escape.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll go see how everyone else is doing.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to rest in bed?
Free Time will end if you do.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's a pretty large lamp...
It makes the room nice and bright.

<CLT=cltMIND>Lost of uniforms identical to my own
line the inside of the closet.

<CLT=cltMIND>They prepared everything just to keep us
trapped here...but why?
